        s = s + f.tile_roofline_deficit * (9.19015 * w[5])
        s = s + tl * (3.3618 * w[6])
        s = s + f.wave_count_deficit * (4.29428 * w[7])
        s = s + f.serial_reduction_dependency * (14.7886 * w[8])
        s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * (2.13869 * w[9])
    else:
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.instruction_density) * (41761.4 * w[10])
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * (11.3099 * w[11])
        s = s + f.resident_block_scarcity * (4.01532 * w[12])

        s = s + f.serial_reduction_dependency * (14.472 * w[16])
        s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * (2.12261 * w[17])
    return s
